stem: How is the setting of the river important to the plot of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: The river is where Mother Crow wants to build a nest.

options.label: B
options.text: The river is where Father Crow meets with the fox.

options.label: C
options.text: The river is where Mother Crow picks up the necklace.

options.label: D
options.text: The river is where Father Crow wants the snake to live.
